name: CORPONATION FUTURES EXCHANGE: Live Prediction Market
description: CFX is a licensed prediction market platform where participants bet Quanta on corponation stock movements, political appointment outcomes, district-level crime index shifts, and weather event probabilities across the Great Lakes corridor. Operated by Meridian Synthesis Group under Sable Charter financial derivatives law, CFX blurs the line between gambling and investment — Tier 4 corporate employees use it as a salary supplement, while Tier 3 users treat it as a lottery with better odds. Real-time BCI data feeds allow registered users to receive micro-alerts on market shifts, and the platform's 'civic weather' module — betting on precipitation, flood events, and thermal inversions — has become unexpectedly popular following the destabilized lake climate of the 2190s.
story_hooks: A Tier 2 janitor with unauthorized BCI access to a Tier 4 executive's meeting room has been making suspiciously accurate CFX calls — and someone has noticed.
A character is hired to place a series of CFX positions designed to signal a false corponation merger and manipulate a rival's stock behavior.
The CFX civic weather module predicts a catastrophic lake flood event with 94% confidence — but the market position data suggests someone placed that bet before any public meteorological warning.
